# Resilient_Satellite_Mesh

**Domain**: Cross

## Definition
A distributed satellite network (e.g., Blackjack) designed to maintain functionality despite anti-satellite attacks through redundancy and dynamic reconfiguration. Requires topology-aware routing and in-network fault tolerance, aligning with TCC's focus on adaptive network architectures.
